name: phone
description: Voice calls with the Hive from the dashboard's Call button: talk naturally to Hive or to any agent. Speech runs on this machine (Whisper large-v3-turbo in, Kokoro out), on the GPU when there is one, else the CPU. Off until `phone setup` builds it (~2 GB of models). "Put me through to whoever's on X" hands the call to that agent; agents ring the person with `phone ring`. Service hive-phone on a private socket (~/.hive/phone.sock), proxied by the dash at /api/phone/.
